admission.justification: A repeated retirement request trusts the retained proof, so the proof must be unwritable by any other operation; the family states the recoverable retirement this protects.

applicability: Generic task-document operations over a sprint row that carries a retirement proof.
conditions: Only task_doc.retire_master writes such a row.
statement: A retirement proof cannot be added, changed or removed through the generic task-document operations; only task_doc.retire_master writes it.
